translations.literal: At the time court arrangements were not yet complete; Youzhou custom was by nature fierce and violent, especially unwilling to have literary Confucians as commanders; staff accustomed to the usual ways resented their changes, their discussions were not kept secret, and suddenly rebellion arose.
translations.idiomatic: At the time court arrangements were not yet complete; Youzhou custom was fierce and violent, especially unwilling to accept literary Confucians as commanders; staff accustomed to routine resented the changes, their discussions were not kept secret, and rebellion suddenly broke out.

sentences.zh: 雍時家亦從劫，蕭氏聞難號呼，專執夫袂，左右格去，以死不從。

translations.literal: Yong's household was also caught in the plunder; hearing the calamity Xiao cried out and clutched her husband's sleeve; attendants pulled her away, but she would not follow even unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Yong's household was also caught in the plunder; hearing the calamity Xiao cried out and clutched her husband's sleeve; attendants pulled her away, but she would not leave even unto death.

sentences.zh: 及雍臨刃，蕭氏涕而告曰：「妾不幸年少，義不茍活；

translations.literal: As Yong faced the blade, Xiao wept and said: "I am unfortunate in my youth; by righteousness I will not live in degradation;
translations.idiomatic: As Yong faced the blade, Xiao wept and said, "I am unfortunate in my youth; by righteousness I will not live in degradation;

sentences.zh: 今日之事，願先就死！」

translations.literal: in today's affair, I wish to die first!"
translations.idiomatic: in today's affair, I wish to die first!"

sentences.zh: 執刃者斷其臂而殺雍，蕭氏詞氣不撓，雖兇悍圜視，無不嗟嘆。

translations.literal: The blade-wielder cut off her arm and killed Yong; Xiao's words and spirit did not bend—even the fierce bandits who looked on all sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: The executioner cut off her arm and killed Yong; Xiao's words and spirit did not bend—even the fierce rebels who looked on all sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 其夕，蕭氏亦卒，

translations.literal: That evening Xiao also died.
translations.idiomatic: That evening Xiao also died.

sentences.zh: 節度使楊志誠表明其事，因降敕追封蘭陵縣君。

translations.literal: Military Governor Yang Zhicheng reported the facts; by edict she was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Lanling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Military Governor Yang Zhicheng reported the facts; by edict she was posthumously enfeoffed Lady of Lanling Commandery.

sentences.zh: 衡方厚妻昌縣君程氏衡方厚妻程氏。

translations.literal: Cheng Shi, Lady of Chang County, wife of Heng Fanghou.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Shi, Lady of Chang County, wife of Heng Fanghou.

sentences.zh: 方厚，太和中任邕州都督府錄事參軍，為招討使董昌齡誣枉殺之。

translations.literal: Fanghou, in the Taihe era served as Recorder of Yongzhou Regional Commandery; he was falsely accused and killed by Pacification Commissioner Dong Changling.
translations.idiomatic: Fanghou, in the Taihe era served as Recorder of Yong Regional Commandery; he was falsely accused and killed by Pacification Commissioner Dong Changling.

sentences.zh: 程氏力不能免，乃抑其哀，如非冤者。

translations.literal: Cheng could not prevent it; she then suppressed her grief as though he were not wronged.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng could not prevent it; she suppressed her grief as though he were not wronged.

sentences.zh: 昌齡雅不疑慮，聽其歸葬。

translations.literal: Changling in his usual manner did not suspect; he allowed her to return and bury him.
translations.idiomatic: Changling, unsuspecting, allowed her to return and bury him.

sentences.zh: 程氏故得以徒行詣闕，截耳於右銀臺門，告夫被殺之冤。

translations.literal: Cheng was thus able to travel on foot to court, cut off her ear at the Right Silver Terrace Gate, and report her husband's murder as a wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng thus traveled on foot to court, cut off her ear at the Right Silver Terrace Gate, and reported her husband's wrongful death.

sentences.zh: 御史臺鞫之，得實，諫官亦有章疏，故昌齡再受譴逐。

translations.literal: The Censorate investigated and found the facts; remonstrance officials also submitted memorials, so Changling was again demoted and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate investigated and confirmed the facts; remonstrance officials also submitted memorials, and Changling was again demoted and expelled.

sentences.zh: 程氏，降敕曰：「乃者吏為不道，虐殺爾夫，詣闕申冤，徒行萬里，崎嶇逼畏，濱於危亡。

translations.literal: An edict to Cheng said: "Recently officials acted without the Way and cruelly killed your husband; you went to court to declare your wrong, traveling on foot ten thousand li, through hardship and fear, near to peril and death.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to Cheng said, "Recently officials acted without the Way and cruelly killed your husband; you went to court to declare your wrong, traveling on foot ten thousand li through hardship and fear, near to peril and death.

sentences.zh: 血誠即昭，幽憤果雪，雖古之烈婦，何以加焉！

translations.literal: Your blood sincerity is now manifest; hidden grievance is truly cleared—though heroic women of antiquity, how could one add to this!
translations.idiomatic: Your blood sincerity is now manifest; hidden grievance is truly cleared—what heroic woman of antiquity could surpass this!

sentences.zh: 如聞孤孀無依，晝哭待盡，俾榮祿養，仍賜疏封。

translations.literal: We hear the lone widow has no support, weeping by day until her strength is spent—grant her honorary stipend for support and still bestow a noble title.
translations.idiomatic: We hear the lone widow has no support, weeping by day until her strength is spent—grant her honorary stipend and still bestow a noble title.

sentences.zh: 可封武昌縣君，仍賜一子九品正員官。」

translations.literal: She may be enfeoffed Lady of Wuchang County, and one son granted a ninth-rank regular official post.
translations.idiomatic: She may be enfeoffed Lady of Wuchang County, and one son granted a ninth-rank regular official post.

sentences.zh: 女道士李玄真女道士李玄真，越王貞之玄孫。

translations.literal: The female Daoist Li Xuanzhen—the female Daoist Li Xuanzhen was a great-great-granddaughter of Prince Zhen of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The female Daoist Li Xuanzhen was a great-great-granddaughter of Prince Zhen of Yue.

sentences.zh: 曾祖珍子，越王張六男也。

translations.literal: Her great-grandfather Zhenzi was the sixth son of Prince Zhen of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Her great-grandfather Zhenzi was the sixth son of Prince Zhen of Yue.

sentences.zh: 先天中得罪，配流嶺南。

translations.literal: During the Xiantian era he offended and was banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantian era he offended and was banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 玄真祖、父，皆亡歿於嶺外。

translations.literal: Xuanzhen's grandfather and father both died in exile beyond the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzhen's grandfather and father both died in exile beyond the mountains.

sentences.zh: 雖曾經恩赦，而未昭雪。

translations.literal: Though there had once been an amnesty, their names were not yet cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Though amnesties had been granted, their names were not yet cleared.

sentences.zh: 玄真進狀曰：「去開成三年十二月內得嶺南節度使盧鈞出俸錢接措，哀妾三代旅櫬暴露，各在一方，特與發遣，歸就大塋合祔。

translations.literal: Xuanzhen submitted a petition: "Within the twelfth month of the third year of the Kaicheng era I received support arranged from the salary funds of Lingnan Military Governor Lu Jun; grieving that three generations of my family's traveling coffins lay exposed, each in a different place, I specially obtained permission to send them off and return them to the great tomb for joint burial.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzhen submitted a petition: "In the twelfth month of the third year of the Kaicheng era I received support from the salary funds of Lingnan Military Governor Lu Jun; grieving that three generations of my family's traveling coffins lay exposed in separate places, I obtained permission to send them off for joint burial in the ancestral tomb.

sentences.zh: 今護四喪，已到長樂旅店權下，未委故越王墳所在，伏乞天恩，允妾所奏，許歸大塋。

translations.literal: Now escorting four coffins, they have reached Chang'an Prefecture's inn for temporary lodging; the location of the late Prince of Yue's tomb is not yet known—I beg Heaven's grace to grant my petition and permit return to the great tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Now escorting four coffins, they have reached an inn in Chang'an Prefecture; the location of the late Prince of Yue's tomb is unknown—I beg the court's grace to grant my petition and permit return to the ancestral tomb.

sentences.zh: 妾年已六十三，孤露家貧，更無依倚。」

translations.literal: I am already sixty-three, orphaned and exposed, my household poor, with no further support."
translations.idiomatic: I am already sixty-three, orphaned and poor, with no one to rely upon."

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「越王事跡，國史著明，枉陷非辜，尋已洗雪。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic histories; wrongly implicated without guilt, he has long since been cleared.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "The deeds of the Prince of Yue are clearly recorded in the dynastic histories; wrongly implicated without guilt, he has long since been cleared.

sentences.zh: 其珍子他事配流，數代漂零，不還京國。

translations.literal: Zhenzi's other offenses led to banishment; for generations they drifted and did not return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzi's other offenses led to banishment; for generations they drifted and did not return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 玄真弱女，孝節卓然，啟護四喪，綿歷萬里；

translations.literal: Xuanzhen, a weak woman, her filial integrity outstanding, escorted four coffins across ten thousand li;
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzhen, a frail woman of outstanding filial integrity, escorted four coffins across ten thousand li;

sentences.zh: 況是近族，必可加恩。

translations.literal: moreover she is near kin—favor must certainly be increased.
translations.idiomatic: moreover she is near kin—favor must certainly be extended.

sentences.zh: 行路猶或嗟稱，朝廷固須恤助。

translations.literal: Travelers on the road still sigh in praise; the court should surely provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers on the road still sigh in praise; the court should surely provide relief.

sentences.zh: 委宗正寺、京兆府與訪越王墳墓報知。

translations.literal: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and Jingzhao Prefecture to seek the Prince of Yue's tomb and report.
translations.idiomatic: Commission the Court of the Imperial Clan and Jingzhao Prefecture to locate the Prince of Yue's tomb and report.

sentences.zh: 如不是陪陵，任祔塋次卜葬。

translations.literal: If it is not an attendant burial mound, permit burial in the secondary rank of the tomb precinct as divined.
translations.idiomatic: If it is not an attendant burial mound, permit burial in the secondary rank of the tomb precinct as divined.

sentences.zh: 其葬事仍令京兆府接措，必使備禮。

translations.literal: The funeral affairs are still to be handled by Jingzhao Prefecture, which must ensure full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao Prefecture shall handle the funeral and ensure full rites.

sentences.zh: 葬畢，玄真如願住京城，便配咸宜觀安置。」

translations.literal: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to dwell in the capital, assign her to Xianyi Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: When the burial is complete, if Xuanzhen wishes to remain in the capital, assign her to Xianyi Abbey.

sentences.zh: 孝女王和子孝女王和子者，徐州人。

translations.literal: The Filial Daughter Wang Hezi—the Filial Daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Filial Daughter Wang Hezi was a native of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 其父及兄為防秋卒，戍涇州。

translations.literal: Her father and elder brother were frontier-defense soldiers garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Her father and elder brother were frontier soldiers garrisoned at Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元和中，吐蕃寇邊，父兄戰死，無子，母先亡。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era the Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle, leaving no sons; her mother had died earlier.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era Tibetans raided the border; her father and brother died in battle without sons; her mother had died earlier.

sentences.zh: 和子時年十七，聞父兄歿於邊上，被髮徒跣缞裳，獨往涇州。

translations.literal: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound, barefoot, and in hemp mourning garments, she went alone to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hezi was then seventeen; hearing her father and brother had died on the frontier, with hair unbound, barefoot, and in hemp mourning garments, she went alone to Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行丐取父兄之喪，歸徐營葬。

translations.literal: She went begging along the road to recover her father and brother's coffins, returned to Xu, and arranged their burial.
translations.idiomatic: She went begging along the road to recover her father and brother's remains, returned to Xu, and arranged their burial.

sentences.zh: 手植松柏，剪髮壞形，廬於墓所。

translations.literal: With her own hands she planted pine and cypress, cut her hair and marred her form, and lived in a hut at the grave.
translations.idiomatic: With her own hands she planted pine and cypress, cut her hair and marred her form, and lived in a hut at the grave.

sentences.zh: 節度使王智興以狀聞，詔旌表之。

translations.literal: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the facts; an edict marked her gate and lane.
translations.idiomatic: Military Governor Wang Zhixing reported the facts; an edict honored her household.

sentences.zh: 又，兗州瑕丘縣人鄭神佐女，年二十四，先許適馳雄牙官李玄慶。

translations.literal: Also, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yanzhou, aged twenty-four, had first been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Flying Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Also, the daughter of Zheng Shenzuo of Xiqiu County in Yan Prefecture, aged twenty-four, had been betrothed to Li Xuanqing, an officer of the Flying Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 神佐亦為官健，戍慶州。

translations.literal: Shenzuo was also a government soldier garrisoned at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzuo was also a government soldier garrisoned at Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時党項叛，神佐戰死，其母先亡，無子。

translations.literal: At the time the Tangut rebelled; Shenzuo died in battle; her mother had died earlier; there were no sons.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Tangut rebelled; Shenzuo died in battle; her mother had died earlier; there were no sons.

sentences.zh: 女以父戰歿邊城，無由得還，乃剪髮壞形，自往慶州護父喪還，至瑕丘縣進賢鄉馬青村，與母合葬。

translations.literal: The daughter, because her father died in battle on the frontier with no means of return, cut her hair and marred her form, went herself to Qingzhou to escort her father's coffin back, reaching Maqing Village in Jinxian Township of Xiqiu County, and buried him together with her mother.
translations.idiomatic: Because her father died on the frontier with no means of return, she cut her hair and marred her form, went herself to Qing Prefecture to escort his coffin back, and buried him with her mother at Maqing Village in Jinxian Township of Xiqiu County.

sentences.zh: 便廬於墳所，手植松檜，誓不適人。

translations.literal: She then built a hut at the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and swore not to marry.
translations.idiomatic: She built a hut at the grave, planted pine and cypress with her own hands, and swore not to marry.

sentences.zh: 節度使蕭椒以狀奏之曰：「伏以閭里之中，罕知禮教，女子之性，尤昧義方。

translations.literal: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized: "I submit that within villages and lanes ritual teaching is rarely known; the nature of women is especially ignorant of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Military Governor Xiao Jiao memorialized, "Within villages and lanes ritual teaching is rarely known; the nature of women is especially ignorant of righteousness.

sentences.zh: 鄭氏女痛結窮泉，哀深《陟岵》，投身沙磧，歸父遺骸，遠自邊陲，得還閭里。

translations.literal: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep spring, sorrow deep as in 'Ascending the Knoll'—she threw herself into sandy wastes, recovered her father's remains, far from the border marches returning to her native lane."
translations.idiomatic: The daughter of the Zheng clan, grief bound to the deep spring, sorrow deep as in 'Ascending the Knoll'—she threw herself into sandy wastes, recovered her father's remains, and returned from the distant border to her native village."

sentences.zh: 感《蓼莪》以積恨，守丘墓以誓心。

translations.literal: Moved by 'The Smartweed' she accumulated resentment; she guarded the mound and tomb to pledge her heart."
translations.idiomatic: Moved by 'The Smartweed' she accumulated resentment; she guarded the tomb to pledge her heart."

sentences.zh: 克彰孝理之仁，足厲貞方之節。」

translations.literal: She was able to display the benevolence of filial principle and fully inspire the integrity of chaste conduct."
translations.idiomatic: She displayed the benevolence of filial principle and fully inspired the integrity of chaste conduct."

sentences.zh: 詔旌表門閭。

translations.literal: An edict marked her gate and lane.
translations.idiomatic: An edict honored her household.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：政教隆平，男忠女貞。

translations.literal: The encomium says: When government and teaching are peaceful and abundant, men are loyal and women chaste.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: When government and teaching flourish, men are loyal and women chaste.

sentences.zh: 禮以自防，義不茍生。

translations.literal: By ritual they guard themselves; by righteousness they do not live in degradation.
translations.idiomatic: By ritual they guard themselves; by righteousness they do not live in degradation.

sentences.zh: 彤管有煒，蘭閨振聲。

translations.literal: The red brush shines bright; orchid chambers resound with fame.
translations.idiomatic: The red brush shines bright; women's chambers resound with fame.

sentences.zh: 《關雎》合《雅》，始號文明。

translations.literal: 'Guanju' matches the 'Ya'—thus civilization is first named.
translations.idiomatic: 'Guanju' matches the 'Ya' odes—thus civilization is first named.
